task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Remove BOX_MIDDLE from the box stack and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. Since only the top box can be picked, we must first move BOX_TOP to TEMP_TABLE temporarily, then pick BOX_MIDDLE, place it on INSPECTION_TABLE, then retrieve BOX_TOP and place it back on BOX_BOTTOM to restore the stack minus the middle.
assumptions: BOX_TOP is the top of the stack and can be picked first
After removing BOX_TOP, BOX_MIDDLE becomes the top and can be picked
TEMP_TABLE is a valid temporary placement location for BOX_TOP
BOX_TOP can be placed back on BOX_BOTTOM after BOX_MIDDLE is removed
Robot interaction_distance of 2.0 is sufficient for all pick/place operations at the chosen navigation points
